Taj Gibson is coming back home 🔥

After 17 years in the NBA, Gibson announced his retirement a few days after he was traded then waived to the Pelicans.

"Basketball gave me the opportunity to live a dream. As a kid from Brooklyn, NY, I was lucky to get a chance to display my talent on the biggest stage. But this isn’t goodbye to Basketball. It’s the beginning of a new chapter," Gibson said on his retirement post on X.

Instead of taking a year or two to think about what his post-retirement career will be, Gibson wasted no time and hopped on the Bulls coaching staff to work as an assistant under Tiago Splitter.

For Bulls fans, him on the sidelines just feels right.

Gibson started his career with the Bulls and played 8 seasons in what's considered one of the most successful eras in franchise history.

With young frontcourt pieces like Caleb Wilson and Nic Claxton, Gibson now gets the chance to help shape the next generation of Bulls big men.

LaMelo Ball and Dennis Rodman are both listed at 6'7", but the height has never looked so different.

One is a point guard known for long-range threes and triple-doubles 🎯

The other is a power forward known for rebounding and toughness 💪

You'll never see Ball finish a game with 20 rebounds and 0 shot attempts.

You'd be stunned to see Rodman drop 20 points and 10 assists.

Rodman finished his 14-year career as a 5-time champion and 2-time DPOY.

Ball won Rookie of the Year and became a 1x All-Star in his first six years in the NBA.

Both players have completely different play styles, yet they figured out how to impact the game.

That's the beauty of basketball.

6'7" can look very different depending on who's wearing it.
